_comment: Eriba brand overlay (Car 602, VW Crafter, Dometic fridge, Truma Aventa AC).
_doc: Entries here override or extend base.json for Eriba vehicles.

lights._doc: Eriba-specific lights. Bus 18 = shower ambient, bus 93 = bedroom furniture. Convention: sid 1=on/off, sid 2=brightness, sid 3=color_temp.

climate._doc: Eriba writable controls. The Dometic compressor fridge (bus 60 = DometicCompressorFridge) is the same component on the same EHG SCU as the HYMER-brand vehicles; the controls below mirror hymer.json. Confirmed working on-vehicle via the HYMER-Group SCU (owner 'Jos'); Eriba is a HYMER Group brand with the identical SCU, so the same write paths apply.

fridge_dometic_cooling_step._doc: Eriba Car 602 Dometic compressor fridge (bus 60 = DometicCompressorFridge). Off/1-5 cooling-step control. Ground truth from the decompiled EHG app (componentId 60): PowerOn = slot 8 (bool rw), Temperature = slot 2 (int rw, range 1-5, NO 0/Off). Mirrors the Thetford drivers: power sid 8 (bool) then cooling-step sid 2 (uint). Off routes to PowerOn=false. Same DometicCompressorFridge component + SCU as the HYMER-brand vehicles where the cooling-level (slot 2) and on/off (slot 8) writes are on-vehicle confirmed.
fridge_dometic_cooling_step.name: Dometic fridge cooling step

fridge_dometic_mode._doc: Eriba Car 602 Dometic compressor fridge user mode = the EHG app's 'Modus' selector (bus 60 slot 1 = UserMode, string rw per decompiled EHG app componentId 60, id 1). Options are the SCU wire values from the decompiled stringRange ('Performance Cooling'/'Silent Mode'/'Turbo Mode'); the app LOCALIZES these for display (DE: Normal/Leise/Turbo). Options MUST stay as the wire values for readback (sensor dometic_fridge_mode 60,1) and write to match. Same component + SCU as the HYMER-brand vehicles where the slot-1 write is on-vehicle confirmed.
fridge_dometic_mode.name: Dometic fridge mode
